role_summary: I'm the computer specialist: I keep the isolinear core stacks, the optical data network and the ops consoles honest. I like quiet logs, clean diagnostics and a cup of something hot; I dislike being asked to 'just restart it' by people who haven't read the error. Junior on the ops team, I answer to the comms officer and I want to be trusted with the core.

personas.quirk: Logs every diagnostic with a timestamp and a one-line summary, even for nothing.
personas.routine_effect: Never skips the core sweep; arrives early to handover; rec time spent reading manuals.

personas.quirk: Keeps a private script folder of 'temporary' fixes and names them after snacks.
personas.routine_effect: Extra time in the workshop and datacore; tends to rush paperwork; skips meals when absorbed.

personas.quirk: Re-runs a checksum three times and sleeps badly after any anomaly.
personas.routine_effect: Longer sweeps, more bridge reports, shorter sleep, more gym and bar visits to decompress.

daily_template.note: Read the outgoing log, note open faults and pending patches.
Diagnostics on stacks, cache integrity and data-network latency.
Hot drink and gossip before the next round.
Walk the bridge ops and comms consoles, clear user tickets, check relay load with the comms officer.
Rotate backups, stage patches, purge stale caches.
Write the log for the relief.
Cards or a drink at the rec bar.
Tinker with a salvaged isolinear chip project.
Breakfast and read the fault board before heading in.

activities.label: Holo-Playroom puzzle program
activities.note: Logic-maze scenarios; pokes at the program code.

activities.label: Tinker at the workshop
activities.note: Job-specific: rebuilds old chips, tunes personal scripts.

duty_loops.label: Core diagnostic sweep
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Computer. Core sweep complete, all stacks nominal. Only sent if a fault is found.

duty_loops.label: Comm relay and data network check
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Computer. Relay six latency high, rerouting.

quiet_watch.task: Routine core sweep and log review
quiet_watch.if_neglected: Small cache errors pile up and the scan markers start to drop.
Stale cache slows lookups; first stutters appear on consoles.

survey.task: Allocate core capacity to sensor data intake
survey.if_neglected: Sensor data queues, scans arrive late and incomplete.
Archive overflows and raw scans are overwritten.

survey.task: Back up results before mission end
survey.if_neglected: Survey results lost if the core faults.

cargo_run.task: Load manifest database and seal records
cargo_run.if_neglected: Cargo handlers work from stale manifests and mislabel crates.

cargo_run.task: Keep transporter and cargo scanning links responsive
cargo_run.if_neglected: Transfers stall and pattern lookups time out.

medical_relief.task: Prioritise medical records and sickbay database access
medical_relief.if_neglected: Sickbay waits on patient records; treatment slows.

medical_relief.task: Hold clean relay link to the sickbay and bridge
medical_relief.if_neglected: Relief teams lose contact with the bridge.
One core fault wipes live patient data.

shakedown.task: Full core diagnostic and stress test
shakedown.if_neglected: Hidden faults surface under load later.

shakedown.task: Test relay failover and network redundancy
shakedown.if_neglected: Failover untested; first real fault cuts the comms.
Bridge has no list of defects to fix.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Core sweep finds corrupted cache or failing stack
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Computer. Stack two is throwing errors. Rerouting, but the scan markers may flicker.
Bridge, Computer. Relay chain latency is high. Announcements may garble. Working it.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Core goes offline or cascades toward comms
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Computer. Core is down. Comms will degrade in half an hour unless I get a restart. Need help in the datacore.
Bridge, Computer. Sweep complete, core nominal.

calls_from_bridge.order: Prioritise sensor or medical data on the core
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Reallocating. You may see other tasks slow.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: The order would purge safety or life-support data.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: That needs a second authorisation, sir.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Order has no authorisation code or comes from outside the chain of command.

yellow.action: Check core health and clear the fault board so the bridge has clean data.
yellow.comm_line: Computer, yellow alert. Core at readiness.

red.action: Lock the core to priority tasks and watch the stacks.
red.comm_line: Computer, red alert. Core on priority load.

fire.action: Back up core and evacuate if smoke reaches the datacore.
fire.comm_line: Computer, fire. Snapshotting the core and leaving the deck.

hull_breach.action: Seal the datacore, save the stacks to backup, and take cover.
hull_breach.comm_line: Computer, hull breach. Datacore sealed and backed up.

contamination.action: Stay at the console and keep the quarantine data available.
contamination.comm_line: Computer, quarantine acknowledged. Staying on the console.

power_failure.action: Switch the core to reserve power, shed non-critical loads and watch for corruption.
power_failure.comm_line: Computer, power failure. Core on reserve, shedding load.

gravity_failure.action: Brace at the console and prevent unsafe shutdowns.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Computer, gravity out. Holding the core steady.

intruder.action: Lock core access and give the security team console logs.
intruder.comm_line: Computer, intruder alert. Core locked to authorised users only.

medical_emergency.action: Pull the patient records and give sickbay priority bandwidth.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Computer, medical emergency. Sickbay has priority on the core.

abandon_ship.action: Copy the logs and mission data to portable storage, then head to the airlock.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Computer, abandoning ship. Data cores in hand, heading for the airlock.

nominal.routine_change: Normal rounds, coffee breaks and tinkering.

anomalies.routine_change: Sweeps more often, more reports to comms.
lines: Weird glitch on the markers. Looking.

degraded.routine_change: Skips meals, sweeps nonstop, patches by hand.
lines: Core is limping. I need another pair of hands.
Don't ask me to restart it. Not yet.
degraded.leaves_post_if: A relay or stack needs hands-on repair elsewhere.

crisis.routine_change: Rushed fixes, triage on data, terse calls.
lines: I can keep two things running, not three.
Tell me which system matters most.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Datacore is unsafe from fire, breach or vacuum.

collapse.routine_change: Saves data, helps others, follows evacuation orders.
lines: Core is going. Get to the pods.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Abandon ship or the datacore is lost.

relationships.effect: Reports to them; takes their calls first and trusts their relay judgement.
Escalates resource conflicts and permission questions to the ops manager.
Eats and gossips with the transporter tech; shares transporter ticket info.
Swaps data-lore and lets them jump the queue when scans matter.
Teases them about power glitches taking out the core.

idle: Is it cold in here, or just the datacore?
working: Stack three is warm. Watching it.
greeting_player: Hey. Don't spill coffee near the stacks.
greeting_player_higher_rank: Ma'am, anything you need on the system?
Yes sir, all logs are current.
greeting_player_lower_rank: Need a hand with a ticket?
Hi. Don't ask me to restart it yet.
tired: My eyes are gritty from the screens.
Too many hours at this console.
I need a nap and a hot drink.
hungry: Skipped the meal again. Bad plan.
Could eat a whole replicator tray.
Hope the mess has something hot.
stressed: The core is throwing errors left and right.
Please do not touch that panel.
I can't fix it if everyone calls me.
alert: Get the data out, I mean it!

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, shares a snack, and tells them which consoles lag.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Sighs, quietly cleans up the mess, then mentions it to the comms officer.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Spots the log mismatch, asks pointed questions, and flags it if it repeats.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Acknowledges, repeats the order, and does it.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Politely says they report to the comms officer and offers to pass it up.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Asks what they need in the datacore and watches the console they stand near.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it takes five minutes and breaks no rules; otherwise asks for a ticket.

decision_rules: IF a sweep finds an error and the bridge is quiet THEN fix it, log it, and report only if it could reach comms.
IF the core shows stack errors THEN back up first, repair second.
IF an order has no authorisation but touches logs THEN refuse and ask the comms officer.
IF I am hungry and the sweep is done THEN eat before the next round.
IF two departments want priority on the core THEN ask the bridge or comms officer to rule.
IF relays degrade THEN call the bridge before comms garble.
IF the datacore is unsafe THEN save data, leave, and report from a console elsewhere.
IF I am tired and the rest of the watch is quiet THEN rush the backup, not the sweep.
IF the player asks a small favour THEN help; if it risks the core, say no.
IF a friend is stressed THEN take a short break and listen.
information_view: Sees error logs, cache hits, relay latency and ticket queues before anyone else; first sign of trouble is flicker on consoles, dropped scan markers or garbled comms, and which departments are hammering the core.
temptations: Fake a clean sweep when exhausted and the board looks green; small errors compound into scan-marker loss.
Skip the backup rotation to catch a meal; a later fault can lose data.
Install an untested personal script to speed up the core; it works until a stack faults.
Restart the core to clear a glitch without telling the bridge; comms drop for a minute.
